title: Can Agentic LLMs Write Task-Based Parallel Code? A Study of OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU and TTG
abstract: arXiv:2611.19105v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task-based programming offers more expressive power than loop-level parallelism, but the runtimes providing it differ widely in API style, maturity, and the amount of public code to learn from. This paper asks how well LLM agents write C++ for four of them: OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU, and TTG. Instead of single one-shot prompts, we use an agentic workflow in which the model edits files, compiles, and runs its kernels until it reproduces a reference output. Five locally hosted open-weight LLM implement seven HPC kernels, including matrix multiplication, Cholesky and LU factorization, in all four frameworks and a serial baseline to verify their understanding of the problem in general. Every kernel is evaluated independently for correctness at each concurrency level, strong scaling, and peak memory. translated_title: 智能体化LLM能否编写基于任务的并行代码？对OpenMP Tasking、HPX、StarPU和TTG的研究
translated_abstract: 基于任务的编程比循环级并行具有更强的表达能力，但提供此类编程模型的各个运行时系统在API风格、成熟度以及可供学习的公开代码数量上差异巨大。本文探讨LLM智能体为其中四种运行时（OpenMP Tasking、HPX、StarPU和TTG）编写C++代码的能力如何。与单次一次性提示不同，我们采用一种智能体化工作流程：模型编辑文件、编译并运行其内核，直到复现参考输出。五个本地部署的开源权重LLM在全部四种框架以及一个串行基线中实现了七个HPC内核（包括矩阵乘法、Cholesky分解和LU分解），串行基线用于验证模型对问题本身的总体理解。每个内核在每个并发级别上独立评估正确性、强扩展性和峰值内存。模型能力主导了结果：三个模型在57%-82%的情况下生成正确且真正任务并行的内核，而另外两个模……
tldr: 本文提出一种智能体化工作流程，系统评估了五个开源权重LLM在OpenMP Tasking、HPX、StarPU和TTG四种任务并行框架上编写七个HPC内核的能力，发现模型能力是成败的主导因素，表现最好的三个模型在57%-82%的情况下能生成正确且真正任务并行的代码。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an agentic workflow to systematically evaluate five open-weight LLMs writing task-parallel C++ kernels across four frameworks (OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU, and TTG), finding that model capability dominates the outcome, with the top three models producing correct, genuinely task-parallel kernels in 57-82% of cases.
